What are the opening hours of the Eiffel Tower?

The Eiffel Tower’s opening hours can vary depending on the season, but generally it is open every day of the year. The typical hours are:

- Mid-June to early September: 9:00 AM to 12:45 AM (last elevator ascent at midnight)
- Rest of the year: 9:30 AM to 11:45 PM (last elevator ascent at 11:00 PM)

It's always a good idea to check the official Eiffel Tower website for the most up-to-date information before your visit, as hours can change due to events or maintenance. Would you like help finding tickets or more details about visiting?

1. 58 Tour Eiffel (now called Madame Brasserie) – Located on the first floor, offering a brasserie-style menu.

Both restaurants are typically open on Sundays, but opening hours and availability may vary, especially due to private events or maintenance.

It’s highly recommended to make a reservation in advance, as these restaurants are very popular, especially on weekends.
